title: drogna scheduler configuration
description: Configuration for C-12, the run scheduler. Thrashing is the failure this component owns, so the two numbers that prevent it — the minimum interval between runs and the timeout after which an outstanding request is abandoned — are configuration rather than constants, and both are measured in simulation time. The common sections are referenced from config.common.schema.json rather than restated.

minimum_interval_seconds.description: Least simulation time between successive run requests. A divergence arriving inside it is declined with a recorded reason, not dropped.

outstanding_timeout_seconds.description: Simulation time after which a request that has produced no publication is abandoned, so that a run which never completes cannot block the loop for ever.

ensemble_size.description: Members to ask each run for. The scheduler owns this number rather than the runner, so that one request carries one answer and two components cannot disagree about how large a run was.

initialisation_offset_seconds.description: Offset from the divergence's simulation time to the instant the run initialises from. Zero initialises at the divergence.

run_id.title: The coverage store's run identifier rule
run_id.description: How a run is named. The rule is the coverage store's, stated in stores/coverage/layout.md, and it is carried here rather than imported so that this component computes the same string from the same five values as the query layer does — root seed, run sequence, rule, version and prefix. Naming the rule and its version in configuration is what makes a change to either change every identifier visibly.

rule.description: The named rule the digest is taken over. Matches query.coverage_store.run_id.rule.

version.description: The rule's version. Bumping it changes every identifier the rule produces.

prefix.description: What a run identifier begins with, so a run directory is recognisable as one.
